description: An avid researcher, interested in space, exploration and travelling
summary: The team created a Minecraft mission for the NASA Space Challenge. Players managed resources, built a rocket with required materials, and successfully completed Phase One with a rocket launch.
details: We created a space exploration game in Minecraft in which a team of scientists detects unusual signals that indicate a possible threat on the Moon. To investigate, we built a NASA-inspired research base on Earth, a rocket with interactive control systems, and a lunar base with living areas and a greenhouse. Players travel to the Moon, collect evidence, analyse clues and work to neutralise the threat. We used Minecraft blocks, redstone, buttons, levers and pistons to model scientific and engineering systems. The project combines space science, sustainable design, creativity, teamwork and problem-solving. Its intended impact is to inspire young people to explore science, technology and engineering, while showing how evidence-based thinking and teamwork can solve complex problems.
